title.narrative: Greening Education through Water Stewardship in UNESCO Biosphere Reserves in Southern Africa

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen water education, climate literacy, and community engagement in environmental stewardship within the Lubombo Biosphere Reserve through the application of citizen science and Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) approaches. Building on previous investments in seven schools, the project will address the remaining gap in the Whole Institution Approach by strengthening partnerships between schools and surrounding communities.
Using UNESCO’s Implementation Guide for UNESCO Sites as Partners for Education for Sustainable Development, learners, educators, community youth, and local stakeholders will participate in hands-on water monitoring, environmental conservation activities, and place-based learning experiences. Citizen science will serve as a key methodology for generating knowledge on local water resources while fostering environmental awareness, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
The project will contribute to improved climate and water literacy, increased community participation in water resource management, and the enhanced use of the Lubombo Biosphere Reserve as a living learning laboratory for sustainability. Through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and practical action, the initiative will support the development of informed and empowered learners and communities committed to protecting water resources and advancing sustainable development.
